text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: {0} and the others were making good progress through the Tower of Luna, fighting off the approaching monsters
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}たちは迫りくる魔物たちを撃退しながら
ルナの塔を順調に進んでいた。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: HYAAAAAAAAAAAH!

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: Gyaoooooo!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: In just one blow... That's amazing. Tomo-chan you're simply too strong, there's no room for me to intervene.
text_block_list.orig_text:
また一撃……
すごいわね。
トモちゃんが強すぎて
私の出る幕がないわ。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Compared to the daily training of the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE held by Jun-san, this is child's play.
text_block_list.orig_text:
【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】の訓練で
ジュンさんに
しごかれるのと比べたら
この程度なんともないですよ。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Mitsuki-san, it would be helpful if you could focus on finding clues to {0}-san's memories.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ミツキさんは
{0}さんの記憶の手がかりを
探すことに集中してもらえると助かります。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: I've actually been looking around for a while now, but all I've seen so far are plants that I'd never have seen before. That said, they're worth picking, so that's a relief.
text_block_list.orig_text:
さっきから周りを見てはいるけど、
目につくのは
見たことのない草ばかりなのよね。
採取のしがいがあって助かるけど。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: True to that, I can see that {0}-san's luggage is steadily increasing...
text_block_list.orig_text:
確かに、
どんどん{0}さんの
荷物が増えてるね……

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Are you okay? If it's getting too heavy, I'll hold some too.
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫？　
重いなら私も持つよ。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: If you say so, {0}-san...
text_block_list.orig_text: {0}さんがそう言うならいいけど……

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Still, are those herbs truly that rare? Would they sell for a high price if you brought them back to Landosol?
text_block_list.orig_text:
それにしても、
そんなに珍しい薬草なんですか？
ランドソルに持ち帰ったら
高く売れるとか？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Hm? Nothing of the sort. It's just that I've never seen any of them before, so they might also be just weeds with no actual properties to speak of.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
そんなことないわよ。
見たことがない、
ってだけで
実際は
なんの薬効もない雑草かもしれないし。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Actually, nine times out of ten they're probably just going to be simple weeds. Simply put, just a type of grass that has crossbred under special conditions and changed in appearance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
というか、
十中八九
雑草でしょうね。
ただの草が
特殊な環境下で交配して
見た目が変化しただけっていう。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Then, why even bother to bring back some grass?
text_block_list.orig_text: ただの雑草を持ち帰るんですか？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Because there's always a possibility they're not. Up until now, I've had plenty of cases where amazing medicines have been created by chance.
text_block_list.orig_text:
もしかしたらっということがあるからよ。
今まで
偶然すごい薬ができたりすることもあったしね。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Amazing medicines... If that's really the case, then she'd have been the talk of town. However, since I've never heard of her name or those medicines, she must've dabbled in shady deals... Okay, this sounds like a lead I can follow.
text_block_list.orig_text:
すごい薬……
もしそうなら、
話題になってるはず。
聞いたことないってことは、
やっぱり裏の世界で……
よし、
情報を引き出してみよう。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Could you give me an example of one of those amazing medicines you made?
text_block_list.orig_text:
例えば
どんな薬ができたんですか？

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: If I were to speak about a medicine you might be interested about, Tomo-chan, let me think... maybe one that heals wounds several times faster than the healing medicines currently on the market, how does that sound?
text_block_list.orig_text:
トモちゃんに関係ありそうなお薬といえば、
そうねぇ……
出回っている傷薬の数倍の速さで
傷を癒す薬、
とかかしら？

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: You really produced something that amazing? In that case, you should definitely sell it to the Royal Knights of NIGHTMARE and...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そんなすごいものが？
それなら
ぜひとも【王宮騎士団（NIGHTMARE）】に……

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: I wish I could sell it, but it's difficult because the materials are too valuable, so it can't be mass-produced.
text_block_list.orig_text:
売り込めたらよかったんだけど、
材料が貴重すぎるし
量産もできないから難しいのよね。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: And that's the story of my research in a nutshell. All of its results end up extending to narrow ranges.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私の研究はそんなものばかりよ。
あくまで狭い範疇にしか効果が及ばないの。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Hey you, don't look at me like that. Just because you're part of every of those narrow ranges...
text_block_list.orig_text:
こらそこ、
そんな目で見ない。
いくら
しょっちゅう狭い範囲の中で影響受けてるからって。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Huh? {0}-san, so you were aware of the medicines Mitsuki-san made?
text_block_list.orig_text:
え？　
{0}さんが
ミツキさんの作った薬を知ってるんですか。

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: Um... Th-That's...
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっと……
そ、
それは……

text_block_list.name: Tomo
text_block_list.text: If he's aware of it then, even if Mitsuki-san were to be caught, {0}-san would be arrested too for covering up her deeds...
text_block_list.orig_text:
知っているってことは、
ミツキさんが捕まったら
{0}さんも隠蔽の罪で一緒に……

text_block_list.name: トモ
text_block_list.text:
いや、
それでも悪事は見逃せない！
このまま調査を続けて、
できることなら証拠も押さえる！
text_block_list.orig_text:
いや、
それでも悪事は見逃せない！
このまま調査を続けて、
できることなら証拠も押さえる！

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: Hehe, how cute. She's very much worth teasing.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふっ、
かわいらしいわね。
からかいがいがあるわ。

text_block_list.name: Mitsuki
text_block_list.text: It's nothing. Don't worry about it.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんでもないわ。
気にしないで。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As Tomo and Mitsuki's plans were steadily reaching a collision, {0} spurred the others to continue investigating the Tower.
text_block_list.orig_text:
トモとミツキ、二人の思惑が交差しつつ、
{0}たちは塔を登っていくのであった。
